scope: source delivery only; no hosted activation, no autonomous action, no natural-event acceptance claim

implemented.resolver: services/evolution/approved_baselines.py resolve_member_baseline approves only with: approved registry entry, checksum/tenant/embedded artifact checksum, replication_success True, an admitted replication_proof whose single real_backtest_validation passed with all checks true and numbers equal to evaluation_summary, round_trips > 0, and an authoritative BacktestRunStore run_record (completed, artifact_checksum == member checksum) for that run id. Summary Sharpe above a threshold or a run id in lineage is never treated as a verdict. Missing/failed/foreign proof or no run_record -> explicit no_approved_baseline reason (e.g. backtest_run_binding_unavailable).
implemented.return_basis: RETURN_BASIS is the gate's real basis (share-sized per-instrument vectorbt portfolios, daily sqrt(252), Taiwan fill costs, multi-symbol = mean of per-instrument Sharpe). member_virtual_book net_of_costs is labelled underlying_exposure_fraction_net_taiwan_costs_equal_notional, so compare_member_book reports incomparable_return_basis instead of a fabricated delta. Final-exit cost is now charged on the interval ending at the exit mark.
implemented.runtime_entry_point: paper_runtime._member_book_snapshot resolves each member through the registry owner reader plus an injectable _member_run_record_reader (BacktestRunStore.get); no default run store is provisioned, so without it members report backtest_run_binding_unavailable. PersonaStrategyPoolStore takes an optional run_record_reader likewise.
implemented.pool_entry_point: persona_strategy_pool.py PersonaStrategyPoolStore.member_baselines (read-only, keyed by pool_version, artifact_ref, checksum)

tests: Recorded Taiwan backtest fixtures (recorded_backtest_tw_2330 / _2330_2317) -> real ReplicationGate -> create_promotion_request -> registry-shaped entry -> runtime snapshot with two members with different baselines; decaying member flagged while a combined series looks healthy; negative cases for unapproved, wrong tenant/checksum/universe/child, missing run/lineage/metrics, failed gate, incomparable basis

validation.command: /tmp/persona-portfolio-venv/bin/python -m pytest test_persona_strategy_pool, test_approved_baselines, test_member_virtual_book, test_portfolio_envelope_parity, test_paper_runtime, test_runtime_summary_projection, test_performance_telemetry

remaining_gaps: ACCEPTANCE 3 NOT MET: the member virtual book is exposure-fraction/equal-notional; the gate is share-sized per-instrument with mean Sharpe. No parity implementation exists, so every real comparison is incomparable_return_basis. Parity needs the member's order_quantity/init_cash sizing plumbed into the book (owner decision / follow-up).

No production source of the authoritative BacktestRunStore record is provisioned (registry entry persists no run-to-checksum binding). Needs an owner-side field or store wiring via the artifact-contract flow; until then production members report backtest_run_binding_unavailable.
Tests use recorded fixtures, no hosted market-day claim. Autonomous member actions remain with EVOLUTION-POOL-MEMBER-ACTIONS and POOL-ADMISSION-AND-WEIGHTS.
